source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 18 Income Taxes, Income Taxes Paid (in millions)
source.quote: The Company paid income taxes, net of refunds, by jurisdiction for the years ended December 31, as follows: ... Total $ 3,020 $ 3,252 $ 2,746 [USD millions; FY2025 is the 1st figure in the row]

notes: Taxes: income taxes paid, net of refunds, from the FY2025 10-K income-tax note by jurisdiction (federal 1,359, state 95, foreign: Belgium 668, United Kingdom 330, Brazil 168, other 400; total 3,020 million). R&D is not reported as a separate line in the FY2025 10-K.
